objective: Implement and independently verify one tiny deterministic Python command-line tool through the autonomous Planner, Builder, and Inspector path.

behavior.input: One UTF-8 file path argument; maximum 4096 bytes.
behavior.output: One canonical compact JSON line with keys byte_count, sha256, and text.
behavior.digest: Lowercase SHA-256 of the exact input bytes.
behavior.errors: Nonzero exit with a concise stderr message for missing arguments, unreadable files, invalid UTF-8, or oversized input.

acceptance: ASCII and Unicode input produce deterministic canonical JSON and the exact byte digest.
Missing, unreadable, invalid UTF-8, and over-4096-byte inputs fail closed without partial stdout.
Implementation uses only the Python standard library and performs no network access.
Builder changes only the two allowlisted paths.
Inspector binds its verdict to the exact Builder commit and reruns the required tests.
prohibited: Secrets, credentials, personal data, employer data, or external network calls.
Changes outside the two allowlisted implementation paths.
Workflow, branch-rule, permission, release, deployment, or Factory-control changes.
